statement: A digest-verifying claim projector converts only current schema-valid evidence into analytical_bound, measured_p0, certified_profile, or no_claim outputs and faithfully preserves calculator error, uncertainty, practical insignificance, regressions, neutral outcomes, alternative wins, invalid evidence, and expired certification.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until the calculator and every preregistered comparative workload Quest are terminal.

The projection must preserve prediction error, regressions, neutral outcomes, practical insignificance, and alternative wins without selective omission or promotional wording.
